company.name: Anyvite
company.shortDescription: Anyvite is a free site allowing users to create event invitations and organize groups for parties.
company.description: [Anyvite](http://anyvite.com) is a free site dedicated to event invitation creation and group organization. Launched in 2008, Anyvite provides users with the most efficient way to create invitations as well as offers the tools necessary to organize and communicate with attendees throughout the event lifecycle.

productsAndServices.description: A web-based tool that allows users to create event invitations quickly with minimal required information.

productsAndServices.description: A system to build and manage guest lists by importing contacts and tracking RSVPs for events.

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows event hosts to sell tickets and collect payments directly through the platform.

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows users to add events directly to popular calendar applications like iCal, Google Calendar, and Outlook.
productsAndServices.name: Calendar Integration

productsAndServices.description: A mobile-friendly interface that allows users to create, manage, and update invitations and guest lists on the go.
productsAndServices.name: Mobile Access and Management
